name: Bulgarian split squat
summary: Single-leg squat with the rear foot on a sofa; the main leg exercise when the load is light.
steps: Stand about a long step in front of the sofa and put the top of the rear foot on it.
Hold the dumbbell at the side (or a band under the front foot).
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Drive through the whole front foot to stand up. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
commonMistakes: Pushing off with the rear leg.
breathing: Inhale on the way down, exhale while standing up.
easier: Split squat with both feet on the floor, or hold a support.
harder: Add load, slow down or pause at the bottom.
contraindications: Knee pain that gets worse during the set.

start.alt: Standing tall with the rear foot on a sofa and a dumbbell at the side.

end.alt: Bottom of the split squat: front thigh near parallel, rear knee close to the floor.
